name: Persistent Ex86 (PEx86)
description: Extends the Px86 (Px86sim) persistency model of Raad et al. to cover the full range of Intel-x86 memory types (uncacheable, write-combined, write-through, write-back) and non-temporal stores (MOVNT), together with their subtle interactions, validated by extensive testing on real Intel-x86 hardware. PEx86 is a conservative extension of Px86sim: for programs restricted to regular stores on write-back memory it coincides with Px86, differing only in a minor divergence over flush/flushopt ordering that PEx86 drops to follow the updated Intel manual. Given both operationally and declaratively.

catSupport.note: Declarative model of x86 memory types and non-temporal stores plus persistency. The consistency half is mixed-size cat territory (x86tso-mixed.cat); the persist dimension is not part of any shipped cat model.
